newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Reputed Colombian drug lord arrested in Venezuela.
newsitem.headline: Reputed Colombian drug lord arrested in Venezuela.

text.p: A reputed drug lord often described as one of the wealthiest men in Colombia has been arrested in Venezuela, authorities said on Friday.

They said Justo Pastor Perafan, whose personal fortune has been estimated by Colombia's leading news magazine Semana at $12 billion, was detained late on Thursday on the outskirts of the city of San Cristobal, just across Colombia's northeast border with Venezuela.

Perafan, whose business interests extend from Bogota to Madrid, Rome and Moscow, has been the target of a nationwide manhunt in Colombia for more than a year. Police had offered a $500,000 reward for information leading to his arrest.

Police sources told Reuters Police Commander Gen. Rosso Jose Serrano and Luis Enrique Montenegro, chief of Colombia's state security police, flew to Venezuela before dawn on Friday to seek Perafan's immediate extradition to Colombia.
Police say Perafan, a 51-year-old former army sergeant and head of the Bogota drug cartel, was using false papers in Venezuela that identified him as Rafael Antonio Cruz Roja.
He has been accused of shipping more than 4,400 pounds (2,000 kg) of cocaine to Italy and other countries.
